named_entities.note: Body `எயினன்` and `வாகை` are retained as unresolved source-level mentions.

tinai_turai.note: The printed source note is preserved as source-context/classification evidence alongside its explicit damage statement and `சிறப்பு` note; damaged lines are not reconstructed.

named_entities.note: `தித்தன்` and `உறந்தை` are retained as unresolved source-level mentions.

textual_intertextual_relationships.note: The source explicitly states `இடையிடை சிதைவுற்ற செய்யுள் இது` and prints `சிறப்பு: தித்தன் காலத்து உறந்தையின் நெல் வளம்.`; these are preserved without reconstructing damaged text.

communities_social_groups.note: `தொல்குடி` is preserved exactly as source terminology; no later community or hierarchy equivalence is imposed.

knowledge_technology.note: Craft and wound-care wording is retained as source technical/practical evidence without mapping it to a modern medical system.

body_health.note: Blood, wounds and `பஞ்சியும் களையாப் புண்ணர்` are source bodily/care evidence; no modern diagnosis is imposed.

empty_notes.textual_intertextual_relationships: The record is incomplete/lacunose; no separate printed textual/classification variant is supplied and missing text is not reconstructed.

landscape_environment.note: `நீஇர் இன்மை` is retained as explicit environmental absence in the surviving source record only; it is not generalized beyond this poem.

textual_intertextual_relationships.note: The source note preserves unknown poet attribution, thurai `பெயர் தெரிந்திலது`, and `தோற்றக் கிடையாத போயின செய்யுள் இது.` as explicit source-loss/uncertainty evidence; the lost poem is not reconstructed.

empty_notes.named_entities: The poet is explicitly unknown; `பெயர் தெரிந்திலது` is not a named entity.
